sourceChecks.text: “The tribe of Zebulun: the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 人口調査の名簿で、ゼブルン族からヘロンの子エリアブが挙げられます。

sourceChecks.text: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 人口調査の名簿で、ゼブルン族からヘロンの子エリアブが挙げられます。

sourceChecks.text: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 人口調査の名簿で、ゼブルン族からヘロンの子エリアブが挙げられます。

sourceChecks.text: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.
